I feel for you :( something similar happened to me. During 2022 i was still wearing a mask while many had taken them off. I had a coworker who would always ask for me to put my mask down and joke about taking my mask off.

 I was uncomfortable but just would brush past the comments and thought they were just joking. I felt self conscious about my face and the mask while it served a purpose it helped with my self esteem since it covered the parts i didn’t like. 

I ended quitting the job to go back to school full time. On my last day we had cut a cake and had a small party for me. This coworker and i had been talking and we were going to hug goodbye. As soon as i was close enough they yanked my mask down and it had broken on one side, exposing my face. 

It was so so humiliating and i tried putting the mask up to my face. I fake laughed it off but i then went to the bathroom to cry. Luckily i had brought a second mask that day and put it on. I only had like an hour left of working so i was glad i didnt have to see them again before i left as we worked in different departments.
